title: Track Projects
subtitle: Seventeen guided projects that turn each learning track into something you can build and verify.

projects.title: Debug a Local Web App
projects.goal: Use the runtime mental models from this track to diagnose a deliberately broken local web application without guessing.

projects.title: Build Static TaskFlow
projects.goal: Build an accessible, responsive TaskFlow interface before introducing JavaScript or React.

projects.title: Build TaskFlow Lite in JavaScript
projects.goal: Turn the static page into a working task manager using only browser JavaScript so the language fundamentals are visible.

projects.title: Migrate TaskFlow Lite to TypeScript
projects.goal: Move the working JavaScript TaskFlow Lite into TypeScript without hiding the runtime boundaries.

projects.title: Build TaskFlow Lite in React
projects.goal: Rebuild TaskFlow Lite in React while keeping state ownership, derived values, effects, and component boundaries easy to explain.

projects.title: Build the TaskFlow Web Shell
projects.goal: Turn the React mental model into a real Next.js App Router application with deliberate server/client boundaries.

projects.title: Build the TaskFlow API Module
projects.goal: Create a NestJS/Fastify Tasks module and trace one request through the framework pipeline.

projects.title: Ship the First Frontend-to-API Vertical Slice
projects.goal: Connect the web app to the API and use browser/network evidence to understand the complete HTTP exchange.

projects.title: Design the TaskFlow PostgreSQL Schema
projects.goal: Build and query the relational model directly in PostgreSQL before introducing the ORM.

projects.title: Add Prisma without Losing the Database Mental Model
projects.goal: Map the known PostgreSQL design into Prisma, inspect generated SQL, and build persistent task operations safely.

projects.title: Complete the Production Tasks API
projects.goal: Build CRUD, validation, error semantics, business rules, filtering, search, stable sorting, and pagination as one coherent API.

projects.title: Secure TaskFlow End to End
projects.goal: Add Supabase identity, verify tokens in NestJS, and enforce roles, permissions, ownership, and tenant isolation on the API.

projects.title: Build the Production Task Screen
projects.goal: Build a complete task screen using React Hook Form, Zod, TanStack Query, and deliberate state ownership.

projects.title: Build Collaborative Tasks and Attachments
projects.goal: Add realtime updates and secure file attachments while keeping the database as the durable source of truth.

projects.title: Build a Production Quality Gate
projects.goal: Prove TaskFlow behavior with tests, threat-driven checks, telemetry, and measured performance rather than confidence by inspection.

projects.title: Release TaskFlow
projects.goal: Package the API, verify it in CI, deploy API + web, and prove the production release with smoke tests and rollback notes.

projects.title: Model an Enterprise Procurement Workflow
projects.goal: Transfer the course architecture into a business workflow with approvals, auditability, background work, and tenant boundaries.
